purpose: Chronological market probability and tail calibration benchmark; no executable P&L without depth
universe: All discovered daily temperature series, including inactive/legacy series; report historical coverage and missing series
holdout_access: DENIED until candidate and code are frozen in an append-only release record
initial_data_scope: Coverage metadata for all history; candles and labels scored only in development and validation
baseline: Raw per-contract two-sided quote midpoint for forecast scoring only; bid/ask bounds also scored; never a midpoint fill
confidence: paired block bootstrap by day, block lengths 1/7/14; no contract-level resampling
first_stage: Coverage and source/window audit before any candle score analysis
limitations: series discoverability is not a complete historical listing audit
observation-period mapping must be verified per source
